component.name: 2ine Balls
component.summary: Give your OS/2 applications a home on GNOME
component.project_license: Zlib AND GPL-2.0-only AND MIT AND OFL-1.1

description.p: Install and run OS/2 applications in balls of 2ine. Each ball keeps its own drives, runtime settings, CONFIG.SYS, profiles, registry and installed files.
Map your original installation media, save application launchers and follow application output in a native GNOME interface.
